DIAGNOSIS READY: Palmar Erythrodysesthesia (Hand-Foot Syndrome).

The combination of a pruritic rash and sensory changes (numbness/tingling) specifically localized to the palms, following the exclusion of heavy metal toxicity and metabolic disorders, is clinically characteristic of drug-induced toxicity. This presentation is most commonly associated with chemotherapy agents like capecitabine or 5-fluorouracil. Do you have a history of recent chemotherapy treatment or specific hand-foot syndrome symptoms like burning pain or peeling skin?
